metricDefinitions.movingFraction: Fraction of observed frames with actual rendered root displacement >1e-8cm; NOT Walking flag, intended speed, or exact continuous-time duty cycle.
metricDefinitions.pauses: Contiguous observed zero-displacement frames at nominal30Hz. Full-run maxima and final30 maxima are included; initial/final boundaries may censor them. A pause may have multiple causes.
metricDefinitions.travellingPause: maxTravellingPause covers pauses beginning after activation; maxPause and maxFinal30Pause retain cross-phase pauses.
metricDefinitions.causes: Last scheduled branch decision carried across unvisited frames; schedule_after_segment_end overrides when a completed segment awaits a visit. Planner/cached-no-route is a category, not proof that continuous space is unreachable.
metricDefinitions.forwardLegs: In this candidate the inherited counter counts generated/prefetched legs, not completed legs; do not use it as progress acceptance.
